email: Hi, I was charged twice for my Pro subscription this month. Can you refund the duplicate charge? Invoice #4821 and #4822 are identical.

expected.summary: Customer double-charged for Pro subscription, requesting refund of duplicate invoice.

email: The dashboard loads fine but the export-to-CSV button does nothing when I click it. Chrome 126 on Windows 11. No error shown.

expected.summary: Export-to-CSV button unresponsive on the dashboard in Chrome 126.

email: Love the new dark mode! One small thing - could you add a keyboard shortcut to toggle it? Would save me a trip to settings every evening.

expected.summary: Request for a keyboard shortcut to toggle dark mode.

email: I can't log in since yesterday. Password reset emails never arrive. I checked spam. My account email is on a corporate domain if that matters.

expected.summary: Login broken; password reset emails not arriving, possibly corporate domain filtering.

email: Quick question - do you have a public roadmap anywhere? Trying to decide between your Pro and Team plans for next quarter.

expected.summary: Asking whether a public roadmap exists to inform a plan upgrade decision.

email: Our whole team is locked out. SSO through Okta returns 'SAML assertion invalid' for every user since your maintenance window last night. This is blocking our release.

expected.summary: Org-wide SSO outage via Okta after maintenance window, blocking customer release.

email: The mobile app crashes on launch after the 3.2.0 update. iPhone 13, iOS 17.5. Deleting and reinstalling didn't help.

expected.summary: Mobile app crashes on launch after 3.2.0 update on iOS 17.5.

email: Please add support for exporting reports as PDF, not just CSV. Our finance team refuses to touch anything that isn't a PDF.

expected.summary: Request for PDF export of reports in addition to CSV.

email: Heads up - the docs page for webhooks returns a 404. The link from the integrations settings page is broken.

expected.summary: Webhooks documentation page returns 404 from integrations settings link.

email: I upgraded to the annual plan but my invoice still shows monthly pricing. Which one am I actually on? Please confirm before the next billing cycle.

expected.summary: Invoice shows monthly pricing after upgrading to annual plan; customer wants confirmation.

email: Thanks for the quick fix last week! While I have you - is there any way to bulk-archive old projects? Doing it one by one is painful with 200+ projects.

expected.summary: Request for bulk-archive of projects; one-by-one archiving is slow at 200+ projects.

email: The API rate limit headers seem wrong. X-RateLimit-Remaining says 4000 but I start getting 429s after ~600 requests in a minute.

expected.summary: API rate limit headers report 4000 remaining but 429s begin near 600 requests/minute.

email: How do I delete my account and all associated data? I couldn't find the option in settings. GDPR request, please handle within 30 days.

expected.summary: GDPR account and data deletion request; option not found in settings.

email: Search is returning results from projects I archived months ago. Archived content should be excluded by default, or at least filterable.

expected.summary: Search includes archived project content; should be excluded or filterable.

email: We'd pay extra for an audit log that shows who changed which permission and when. Compliance is asking and I have nothing to show them.

expected.summary: Request for a permissions audit log for compliance purposes.

email: 請求書の宛名を会社名に変更したいです。設定画面に該当する項目が見つかりませんでした。🙏

expected.summary: Customer wants invoice addressed to their company name; setting not found.

email: El widget de análisis muestra 'NaN%' en la columna de conversión desde el martes. Los datos subyacentes se ven bien en la exportación.

expected.summary: Analytics widget shows NaN% in conversion column since Tuesday; underlying data is fine.

email: y'all's new editor is great but it keeps 'helpfully' auto-capitalizing code snippets in my notes — can I turn that off?

expected.summary: User wants to disable auto-capitalization affecting code snippets in notes.

email: PRODUCTION IS DOWN. Every API call returns 500 since 09:40 UTC. Status page says all green which is clearly wrong. We are losing orders right now.

expected.summary: All API calls returning 500 since 09:40 UTC; status page incorrectly green; customer losing orders.

email: My card was declined but you still show my account as past due after I paid with a different card. The dunning emails are getting aggressive.

expected.summary: Account still marked past due after successful payment with a second card; dunning emails continuing.

email: Two-factor codes from your app are rejected about half the time. My phone clock is synced. Started after I switched to the new authenticator flow.

expected.summary: 2FA codes rejected roughly half the time after switching to new authenticator flow.

email: Could the weekly digest email be sent on Mondays instead of Sundays? Or better, let each user pick the day.

expected.summary: Request to configure the weekly digest email day per user.

email: The invite link I sent to a contractor says 'organization seat limit reached' but our admin page shows 3 of 10 seats used.

expected.summary: Invite link reports seat limit reached while admin page shows 3 of 10 seats used.

email: Webhook deliveries to our endpoint stopped on Friday. Your delivery log shows 200 OK responses we never received. Nothing changed on our side.

expected.summary: Webhook deliveries stopped Friday; provider log shows 200 OK responses the customer never received.

email: Any chance of a Linux desktop client? Half our engineering org is on Ubuntu and the web app misses the global hotkeys.

expected.summary: Request for a Linux desktop client; web app lacks global hotkeys.

email: Billing question: if I add 5 seats mid-cycle, is the charge prorated or full price? The pricing page doesn't say.

expected.summary: Asking whether mid-cycle seat additions are prorated; pricing page unclear.

email: The iOS share extension uploads the wrong photo when multiple are selected - always the first one in the camera roll instead of the chosen ones.

expected.summary: iOS share extension uploads first camera-roll photo instead of the selected photos.

email: hey — tiny thing, the confirmation emails say 'You're subscription' instead of 'Your subscription'. drives me nuts every time 😅

expected.summary: Typo in confirmation emails: 'You're subscription' should be 'Your subscription'.
